{{Infobox auto}}
The '''crook''' is a shepherd's staff with long reach, sold by the [[Shepherd|shepherd]]. Held in the main hand it adds 2 blocks of entity reach, and in the off hand 5; in either hand it also adds 1 block of safe fall distance.

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
A level 3 shepherd sells it for one [[Obol|obol]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/shepherd/3/crook.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
It deals 2 damage with an attack speed of 4, mines hoe blocks at speed 8, and has 300 durability. In the main hand it adds 2 blocks of entity reach; in the off hand it adds 5. It adds 1 safe fall distance in either hand. Its tooltip claims 5 damage and 3 reach, which do not match the attributes. It is repaired with sticks.
